claim: AI will only intensify climate change.
time_horizon: Ongoing and future, no end date.
occurrence: Headline of Juan Cole’s article in The Nation, “AI Will Only Intensify Climate Change. The Tech Moguls Don’t Care.” (December 4, 2025).

P1.reason: “Only” treats it as established that AI has no offsetting climate benefits. The IEA describes possible efficiency and climate benefits as conditional: neither proven nor ruled out.

P2.reason: Global scope matches the global data-center evidence; no distinct scope problem.

P3.reason: States a certain outcome. The IEA says the effect depends on demand growth, efficiency and how the electricity is generated, and clean-energy investment is also growing.

W1.reason: No distinct additional problem; the issue is scored once above.

W2.reason: No human-like agency is attributed to AI.

review_status: AI research draft; not independently reviewed
note: Headline claim added October 6, 2026 at Leyla’s request for spicier headlines. Scored with the same claims-us-1.0 rubric; evidence comes from the topic research brief.
